title: Neighbourhood market and rest

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Show ordinary shared moments so a neighbourhood can be understood through social use rather than landmarks alone.
strategic_value: A shopping cart, conversation and resting figures can make Helsinki neighbourhood imagery relatable.
demonstration: Two figures overlap an ochre architectural rail above a shopping cart, seated figures and decorative objects on pink.
practical_value: Use the upper architectural scene or lower social group according to the emphasis of the message.
